items.title: Cafe Sierra | Seafood Buffet
items.description: Airy spot in the Hilton tower for Californian & Pan-Asian eats, a prime rib-seafood buffet & brunch.
items.address: 555 Universal Hollywood Dr, Universal City, CA 91608

updatesFromCustomers.text: Chef Pvel and jose hooked us up with the fatest juiciest lobsters and king crab legs and he gave us garlic butter and cajun butter as well 😋  gotta be exclusive to get some exotic butter lol just kidding all you gotta do is ask. He was so nice and thoughtful! Thank you chef for hooking us up. 🙏  all the food was great i wasnt disappointed with the food at all there was such a big variety even the desserts were so good. It is worth the money! If you make early reservations you get a discount and dont forget to get your valet parking discount as well. The waiters were fast and clean and thorough!  Overall this was my best buffet visit so far. Prime rib was my favorite!  They offered tender beef ribs as well it is a must try at least once! I definitely recommend to all the food lovers.

items.title: Hilton Los Angeles/Universal City
items.description: Sleek 24-story hotel near Universal Studios, featuring Hollywood views, an outdoor pool & a lounge.
items.address: 555 Universal Hollywood Dr, Universal City, CA 91608
items.hotelDescription:
A block from the main entrance of Universal Studios Hollywood, this upscale 24-story hotel is 3 miles from Pantages Theatre in downtown Hollywood.
 Polished rooms offer panoramic views of the Hollywood Hills and Universal Studios, along with custom-designed beds, minifridges, flat-screen TVs and Wi-Fi (fee). Suites add separate living areas and free breakfast.
 A free shuttle to Universal Studios is offered. Amenities include an informal restaurant, a lobby lounge and a coffee shop, plus a fitness center, and an outdoor pool with a seasonal bar and a hot tub. There's also a business center and 35,000 sq ft of meeting space.
